plan.goal: Group points by cluster identifier, compute spatial statistics per cluster, and generate fitted standard deviation ellipse geometries as polygon output
plan.notes: Cluster grouping is based on the 'Type' integer field. For each cluster, compute: (1) mean center (cx, cy), (2) standard deviations (std_x, std_y), (3) covariance matrix for orientation angle, (4) semi-major and semi-minor axes using 1-std or 2-std ellipse as appropriate. Output polygon layer with attributes: cluster_id (from Type), center_x, center_y, std_x, std_y, semi_major, semi_minor, rotation_degrees. Preserve source CRS (Krasovsky 1940 Transverse Mercator) in output.
